# Dynamic QR Code Labs

> Create dynamic QR codes you can edit anytime after printing. Track scans in real time, customize designs, run smart redirects, and manage QR campaigns from one platform.

Dynamic QR Code Labs is a SaaS platform for generating QR codes whose destination URL can be changed at any time after the code is printed. The platform combines a marketing site with deep SEO content (28 in-depth articles, ~87,000 words) and a full product (dashboard, API, redirect engine) under a single brand.

## What we do

A **dynamic QR code** is a QR code whose destination URL is stored in a database and can be changed at any time, without modifying the printed image. Unlike static QR codes (which encode the destination directly into the pixels), dynamic QR codes encode a short redirect URL that we control. When someone scans the code, our edge-deployed redirect engine looks up the current destination, applies any configured smart-redirect rules (device, country, language, time, A/B split), logs an anonymized scan event, and redirects the visitor — all in 30-60 milliseconds, globally.

This means you can:
- Change a QR's destination URL forever after printing (no reprints required)
- Track scan analytics with privacy-friendly defaults (hashed IPs, approximate location)
- Run smart redirects based on device, country, language, or time
- Pause, revoke, or expire codes from the dashboard
- Use custom branded short domains for all your codes
